subject.title: cli: status line機能のPhase 1を追加

question: Should this owner-authored CLI feature be approved only after terminal-control sanitization is added to the status-line display path?
rationale: The concrete repair is clear, but the repository policy requires explicit maintainer handling for owner-authored pull requests.

options.title: Require sanitization before merge
options.body: Strip terminal-control bytes from dynamic status-line fields and add a regression test before approving the PR.

options.title: Accept the terminal-display risk
options.body: Merge the feature with the known ability for persona-derived data to alter terminal state.

recommendation.title: Require sanitization before merge
recommendation.body: Strip terminal-control bytes from dynamic status-line fields and add a regression test before approving the PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed status-line feature and its follow-on design work.
